title: Machine Learning Model Evaluation: Accuracy Paradox and Better Metrics

cues.en: Here I've got a confusion matrix and this confusion matrix has 10000 records in it and it represents
cues.zh: 這裡是一個包含 10000 筆紀錄的混淆矩陣，代表

cues.en: scenario number one which we'll be looking at as you can see this model has made 150 type 1 errors and 50 type 2 errors.
cues.zh: 要介紹的情境一。可以看到，模型有 150 個第一類錯誤和 50 個第二類錯誤，

cues.en: And but overall it's predicted quite a lot correctly.
cues.zh: 但整體正確預測很多。

cues.en: Now let's calculate the accuracy rate in this scenario the accuracy rate is the total correct word.
cues.zh: 現在計算這個情境的準確率，就是正確總數

cues.en: But overall total and it's 9800 divided by 10000 which is 90 percent.
cues.zh: 除以全部總數，9800 除以 10000，也就是 98%。

cues.en: Okay great but what are we going to do now is we're going to tell the model to stop making predictions whatsoever which is going to abandon them all completely.
cues.zh: 很好。接著我們要讓模型完全停止預測，徹底放棄使用模型，

cues.en: And we're going to say that from now on our prediction is always zero.
cues.zh: 改成從現在起預測永遠是 0，

cues.en: We're always going to predict that the event is not going to occur.
cues.zh: 永遠預測事件不會發生。

cues.en: So basically what will happen to the confusion matrix is these records will move from the right call them to the left column and our new confusion matrix will look like this.
cues.zh: 基本上，混淆矩陣右欄的這些紀錄會移到左欄，新矩陣變成這樣，

cues.en: Nine thousand eight hundred fifty 150 and then nothing in the predicted column where we predicted that something will occur.
cues.zh: 9850、150，而預測事件會發生的那一欄全部是空的。

cues.en: And of course that moves against all logic right.
cues.zh: 這當然違反常理，對吧？

cues.en: Why would you abandon a model but let's calculate the accuracy rate in this scenario.
cues.zh: 為什麼要放棄模型？但先計算這種情境的準確率，

cues.en: So in order to accuracy rate has the same formula in this case accuracy rate is nine thousand eight hundred fifty divided by 10000.
cues.zh: 公式一樣，這次是 9850 除以 10000，

cues.en: So it's ninety eight and a half percent the accuracy rate went up by half a percent.
cues.zh: 所以是 98.5%，準確率增加了 0.5 個百分點。

cues.en: And as you can see what we did is we just completely stopped using a model but the accuracy rate went up.
cues.zh: 可以看到，完全停止使用模型，準確率卻上升。

cues.en: And that is why you should not base your judgment just on accuracy right because things like this can
cues.zh: 所以不能只依準確率做判斷，因為可能

cues.en: happen and even though obviously you're not using a model any more which means that you're not applying
cues.zh: 發生這類情況。明明已不使用模型，也就是沒有運用

cues.en: any kind of logic into your decision making process your accuracy rate is going up so it's misleading
cues.zh: 任何邏輯做決策，準確率卻上升，讓你被誤導，

cues.en: you into a wrong conclusion that you should stop using models and this effect is called the accuracy paradox.
cues.zh: 得到應該停用模型的錯誤結論。這個現象稱為準確率悖論。

cues.en: And starting from the next tutorial I will show you a much better way to assess your models using the cumulative accuracy profile of forcing you then.
cues.zh: 從下一堂開始，我會介紹更好的模型評估方法：累積準確度曲線，期待到時見。

cues.en: Until next time happy analyzing
cues.zh: 下次見，祝你分析愉快。
